data.body: **[P1] Define how clients decode offloaded root results and errors.** Unlike chained invokes, top-level execution results are consumed directly from execution history by callers that currently pass the payload to `SerDes`; they have no target-side acceptance setting or envelope decoder. Offloading root output or errors would expose an opaque storage envelope. Either exclude these payloads or define explicit client opt-in and a public load/decode API carrying the producer context, including corresponding testing/history support.
